notes.title: ver1.20 has been released.
notes.content:
Functional Changes

* Princess of Destruction" now supports English!


* The effect description of "Armageddon Sword" was changed.
(Before change)
Armageddon Sword (MP consumption X)
X damage. When unactivated, MP consumption +1, damage +7.
When activated, returns to default.

(After change)
Armageddon Sword (MP consumption 1)
7 damage. When unactivated, MP consumption +1, damage +7.
When activated, returns to default.

notes.title: ver1.11 has been released.
notes.content:
Functional Changes

* The effect description of "Fisticuffs" was changed.
  (Before change) Unarmed attack power +2. +1 attacks for levels 12 and up. +5 extra for levels 20 and up.
  (After change)  Unarmed attack power +2. +1 attacks for levels 12 and up. Power +5 extra for levels 20 and up.

notes.title: ver1.10 has been released.
notes.content:
Functional Changes
.
* The power of enemy actions is now displayed as attack power.
* The right to resurrection by "Crimson Cross" and "Staff of Everlasting Life" is now indicated by an icon in battle.


* When the first step to start was the inn, good things were made to happen.
* Timing of enemy appearances and rewards were adjusted.
* We made it so that there is a low probability of evil appearing even when you don't have the "Serpent Cross".
* When an ogre type is defeated, a special item can be obtained at random.


* When a tiger is turned by "Tiger Sword", the face image is now that of a tiger.
* The damage that accumulates each turn with the "Sword of Armageddon" has been changed from 5 to 7.
* Deleted "Sowrd of Denial".
* Added "Sowrd of Magic Circle".


* The effect of "Fisticuffs" was changed.
  (Before change) Unarmed attack power +2. +4 extra for levels 10 and up. +1 attacks for levels 12 and up.
  (After change)  Unarmed attack power +2. +1 attacks for levels 12 and up. +5 extra for levels 20 and up.


* Ribbonette
  (Before change) 23 Gold, Damage given +2
  (After change)  40 Gold, Damage inflicted by attacks and skills given +5

* Crimson Ribbonette
  (Before change) 45 Gold, Damage given +5
  (After change)  80 Gold, Damage inflicted by attacks and skills given +10

* Changed the effect of "Eye Patch".
  (Before change) Bullet type power +5
  (After change)  Bullet type power +5. Gain one bullet at the start of combat.

* The price of "Crimson Cross" was changed from 9 Gold to 15 Gold.
* The price of "Magic Arrow" was changed from 88 Gold to 64 Gold.


Modification
* Fixed a bug that an effect the "+1 attacks" by "Fisticuffs" and "Earring Tread" isn't had on the "Sword of the Sacrament".
* Fixed a bug that prevented "Dream Crest" item revival from taking precedence over item drops.


and more other minor corrections and balancing

notes.title: ver1.02 has been released.
notes.content:
Functional Changes
.
The clear logs of the last 10 rounds are now recorded and displayed.
Clear logs prior to ver1.02 are not recorded.

Changed the evaluation rules for clear rate and rank.

(Before change)
Ranks are now evaluated based on the “clear rate against the total number of times played.
　　　↓ 
(After the change)
Ranks are evaluated based on the “clear rate of the last 10 rounds.

The rank evaluation will be displayed on the statistics screen as “the highest clear rate/rank so far”.



The effect of “Evil Special Effect” has been changed.

(Before change)
Damage to evil enemies x 1.5 (rounded down)
　　　↓ 
(After the change)
Damage to evil enemies x 1.5 (rounded up)


Modification

Fixed descriptions of “Snake Cross”, “Cross”, and “Ring
Fixed an incorrect amount of recovery for “wind card


Fixed a phenomenon in which the wrong number of episodes was displayed when a button was pressed in Hell Mode.

Other minor corrections and balance adjustments were made.

notes.title: ver 1.01
notes.content:
[Added functions]
Version: Added (can be found in the lower right corner of the credits screen)

Ability Set screen: A message now appears when a slot is available.

[Fixes]

 Achievements
* Achievements: Fixed a phenomenon in which "Seishihime" is released even if the conditions are not met.
  (Achievements that have already been accidentally unlocked will be canceled upon startup.)

* Result screen: Fixed a phenomenon in which the result screen would display incorrectly if the playing time exceeded one hour.
